*An Ahu-Nixta is counted as a **Construct** due to the fact that it cannot function outside of a protective suit of powered armor. An Ahu-Nixta without its armor is treated as a **Humanoid** due to their intelligence and their ability to use tools and equipment, though they share very few features with humans.*

Their origins uncertain, these amorphous but intelligent creatures claim to not be native to our world, rather coming from far beyond the sky. Regardless, they have extensive knowledge of magical engineering, which they mostly use to create exoskeletons. This allows them to move and interact with the world, even without leaving the safety of their shells. Outside of their armor, an ahu-nixta is incredibly weak, only capable of casting basic defense magic to fight back.

Ahu-nixta begin life as drudges, doing whatever menial work is thrust upon them by their overlords, even dying to preserve the lives of their betters. If they serve for enough time, they may be given the chance to evolve into a higher form of being. However, unlike a full soldier, they are unable to survive outside of their armor at all.

H7f1fYMExyKw5gbSeZuF.description:
Once a companion to the druid Sorvek in ages pass. When his friend fell into madness and attempted to kill the Kalra Morga Bagroth joined him, agreeing that no God Beast should be enslaved. 

After the deed was done and Sorvek absorbed a portion of the Kalra's divine essence, Bagroth lay dead, killed by the outpouring of energy. Twisted by his ascension, Sorvek "gifted" his trusted companion with a second and unending life by raising Bagroth as a wight and giving him sway over the bones of the wild creatures of the woods. 

Ages have passed and still Bagroth still serves Sorvek. He no longer agrees with his former companions ideas and plans but can do little about it. So instead he acts to prevent mortals from venturing to close to the Gloamwood where Sorvek hides. As the Doomsayer, Bagroth arrives at a village and warns them to depart. If his warnings are not heeded he returns with his storm of bones to erase all traces of civilization from the land.
